g.text: The IPCC finds a near-linear link: about 0.45°C of warming for every 1,000 billion tonnes of CO2 emitted,

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: likely 0.27 to 0.63°C. By 2025 the total since 1850 was 2,780 billion tonnes; warming was 1.28°C in 2016–25.
